name: EdgeEver
one_liner: An open-source, Evernote-style three-pane notes app you can host on Cloudflare's free tier or with Docker.

text.why: Switching note apps is hard when prices rise or exports are a chore. EdgeEver keeps the familiar Evernote-style three-pane layout, lets you own your data, and says it supports AI agents through MCP.
text.take: It can reportedly run within Cloudflare's free quotas with no server purchase.
build: A three-pane editor with notebooks, tags and search, plus tables, code, formulas, diagrams, backlinks and an outline. Clients for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android and a web clipper are advertised, and there is a live demo.

who.role: People who want to keep their notes under their own control, or leave Evernote.

start.text: Try the demo site first, then follow the deploy guide (Cloudflare or Docker).

caveat: Licensed AGPL-3.0: modified versions offered as a service must share their source. The project is documented mostly with Chinese-language material, and the demo contains Chinese sample notebooks.

license.scope_text: Release source if you redistribute or host it as a service.
